notes.title: Sudden update (v 1.2)
notes.notes:
What is included in the update list:

[list]
[*] Many visual fixes.
[*] Added 3 packs of new sounds (We follow the licenses of sounds!)
[*] Fixed bug when copying.
[*] A warning appeared when you start a new project.
[*] The random color on layers has been removed.
[*] Changed cursors.
[*] Fixed bug when increasing the speed of falling the ball when increasing the camera.
[*] Tutorial transferred to the site.
[*] [url=https://idalgame.itch.io/] There is a demo version that can be downloaded here [/url]
[/list]

[b] In the next update there will be even more bug fixes! [/b]

[i] Do you like the app?
Unfortunately, we do not write much about it .. We believe that the application is not interesting, but we are interested in making it better!

We need your support in the development of the project! [/I]
